learning_outcomes.text: Students perceive the basic concepts of chemistry, grasp its relevance to their own profession, understand natural phenomena using concepts such as atoms, molecules, and energy, and change their perspective on chemistry by briefly and clearly presenting the main principles of each topic.
As students' knowledge increases and problem-solving skills develop, they make progress in interpreting many issues encountered in daily life.
Enable the application of learned topics to different disciplines.
Prepare for practical application in a laboratory setting.
Gain discipline in taking responsibility and working as a team.
